svg.desc: The liveness probe asks whether the process answers HTTP and a failure restarts it; the readiness probe asks whether a model is loaded and a failure only stops traffic to it.

svg.text: Liveness must never depend on anything outside the process: a slow model load would otherwise cause a restart loop.
